text: Your business backs up its files.
But what about its most important person?
Imagine your founder, lead operator or top salesperson suddenly can't work.
Keyman insurance can help protect the business financially if an insured key person dies or experiences another covered event.

text: Depending on the policy, the payout can help fund recruitment, manage immediate expenses and give the business time to recover.
You can't replace an important person overnight.
But you can prepare your business.
Message Keyman to explore your options.
